name: Ashlee Manley
fact: She was president of the Delta Tau chapter of Phi Mu at WKU in 2013-14, the same year she chaired SGA's Legislative Research Committee; the office is printed under her portrait on the chapter composite.

src.label: WKU Archives UA1C11/105/37, Phi Mu Composite 2013-2014

name: Kendrick Bryan
fact: In March 2010 he was SGA's director of academic and student affairs, an Elizabethtown graduate student, and was running for executive vice president against Currie Martin. The roster's listing of him as executive vice president in 2009-10 may therefore be a year early.

name: Devon Hilderbrandt
fact: The Herald spells him Devon Hinderbrandt, not Hilderbrandt. It reported on 1 April 2011 that he was a Bardstown sophomore standing unopposed for administrative vice president, and a Lambda Chi Alpha brother of the sitting vice president Wade Pierce. Spelling flagged, not corrected.

name: Nathan J. Eaton
fact: He stood for the vacant student regent seat in February 2009 against Pineville senior Reagan Gilley, in a two-day Topnet vote on 24 and 25 February; the seat had been empty since 30 January. The Herald describes him as a Fairdale senior, past president of Phi Delta Theta and SGA speaker of the senate.

src.label: College Heights Herald 84:34, 24 February 2009, pp. 1 and 6

name: Kendrick Bryan
fact: He ran for student body president in the spring 2007 election and lost to Jeanne Johnson. The Herald photographed him alone outside the SGA office on results night and called him an Elizabethtown sophomore, which fits the Elizabethtown graduate student it named in 2010.

name: Cherieth L. Lineweaver
fact: She was returned unopposed as administrative vice president in the spring 2007 election with 1,231 votes, and said she wanted to keep working on Organizational Aid. Johnathon Boles was elected executive vice president with 1,283 and Jeanne Johnson president.

name: M. Andrew Eclov
fact: The Herald prints him as 'Drew Eclov' in its list of students elected to the SGA senate in the spring 2008 election, alongside Nathan Eaton, Wade Pierce and Ben Lineweaver.

name: Nathan J. Eaton
fact: The Herald of 5 April 2007 calls him 'campus improvements chair and Fairdale sophomore', which places the committee chairmanship in 2006-07 and gives his home town.
